Why BrandShield?

Trusted by the world’s leading companies

The BrandShield Difference

BrandShield’s mission is to make the internet safer for brands, users, and customers. Our platform combines cutting-edge AI technology with expert-led services rooted in deep expertise in IP law and cybersecurity. We provide end-to-end digital risk protection—detecting, prioritizing, and eliminating critical risks first. From phishing attacks and social media impersonations to IP infringement, counterfeits, fake apps, and fraudulent ads, BrandShield helps organizations stay one step ahead of online threats.

BrandShield Starts Where Others Stop

We identify threats across domains, marketplaces, ads, social platforms, search engines, fake apps, and AI. But detection alone is not enough. Our workflows trigger immediate action, and our enforcement team drives thousands of successful removals each week. This closes the gap between knowing a threat exists and eliminating it.

Get a Complete Picture of Each Brand Threat

BrandShield connects related incidents across channels and surfaces the full pattern behind an attack. Instead of isolated signals, teams see how domains, listings, ads, and social profiles tie together. This unified view helps them understand the scope, identify the root issue, and respond more effectively. The result is better decision making and fewer surprises.

Scale Without More Headcount

BrandShield automates the heavy lifting so threat volume does not overwhelm internal resources. The platform continuously monitors, prioritizes, and routes threats, removing the manual effort that usually slows teams down. Enforcement becomes faster, more consistent, and far more scalable. Organizations get reliable coverage across every channel and predictable takedown performance without hiring additional staff or restructuring their workflows.

Why BrandShield?

BrandShield helps companies take control of the digital threats that exist beyond their firewall. By bringing Online Brand Protection and External Cybersecurity into one AI-powered platform, BrandShield gives teams the visibility and enforcement power needed to protect their brand, customers, employees, and revenue.

Instead of reacting to isolated incidents, BrandShield identifies the patterns, networks, and high-risk threats behind phishing, impersonation, fraud, counterfeits, and other forms of brand abuse. With AI-driven analysis, risk prioritization, and expert-led enforcement, companies can move faster, reduce external risk, and protect customer trust across the digital channels where their brand is exposed.
